title: You weren’t meant to carry everything.
paragraphs: You weren’t meant to carry everything.
Sometimes life feels like carrying a bag of stones up a mountain.
But God never asked you to carry the weight of life alone.

The moment you surrender the burden,
His strength begins to replace your weakness.

“My grace is sufficient for you, for My power is made perfect in weakness.”
— 2 Corinthians 12:9
